certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Internal Combustion Engines

learning_outcomes.text: Explain the four-stroke and two-stroke operating cycles and their thermodynamic basis
Describe the main engine components and their functions
Analyse air-fuel mixing, combustion and the role of ignition timing
Interpret engine performance maps for power, torque and specific fuel consumption
Explain emissions formation and the principal after-treatment technologies
Diagnose common combustion and mechanical faults from symptoms

integrative_case: A tuning workshop is asked to raise a naturally aspirated engine's output while meeting an emissions limit: trainees must reason about air-fuel ratio, ignition timing, induction and after-treatment, then justify a safe calibration envelope.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
